findings.body: The test `every_model_the_defaults_select_has_a_price` calls `unpriced` to find any model in the defaults that is missing from `MODEL_PRICES`. I cannot see the definition of `unpriced` — whether it checks by exact match or by some prefix/pattern, or whether it iterates over `MODEL_PRICES` correctly. If `unpriced` has a different contract than expected (e.g., it only checks a subset, or it is case-sensitive when model names are lowercased elsewhere), the test could pass even when a model is unpriced. This is low confidence because the function likely matches the test's intent, but I couldn't verify it.
